title: Justin George (Aurora flooring company owner) — 'Turns out the pressure is the same at any size'
summary: George owns a flooring company in Aurora, CO. He came to Incorruptible doubting a book aimed at founders who answer to boards would reach a business his size, and left comparing it to his own calls on home renovations: when the real fault in a house is worse than what the customer pictured, eating the cost overrun has paid for itself in goodwill every time.
blockquote: I wasn't sure how relevant Incorruptible would be to me. Eric Ries is writing for founders with boards and investors. I run a small flooring company in Aurora. Turns out the pressure is the same at any size.
